senses.en: to increase rapidly in number

ex.en: Coffee shops have proliferated in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 我们街区的咖啡店越开越多。

ex.en: Without natural predators, the introduced rabbits proliferated across the continent and stripped large areas of vegetation.
ex.zh: 由于没有天敌，引入的兔子在整个大陆上迅速繁殖，啃光了大片植被。

senses.en: Turning animal skin into leather; browning skin in the sun.

ex.en: Tanning hides took weeks.
ex.zh: 鞣制兽皮要花几周时间。

senses.en: The skin and fur of an animal.

ex.en: Beaver pelts were traded to Europeans.
ex.zh: 海狸皮被卖给欧洲人。

senses.en: A person who traps animals for fur.

ex.en: French trappers traveled the rivers.
ex.zh: 法国捕兽人沿河而行。

senses.en: A small glossy shell once used as money.

ex.en: Cowrie shells served as currency in Africa.
ex.zh: 宝贝壳在非洲曾被用作货币。

senses.en: Beads of shells used by Native Americans for trade and records.

ex.en: Wampum belts recorded treaties.
ex.zh: 贝壳串珠腰带记录了条约。

senses.en: An underground channel bringing water from hills.

ex.en: Persian qanats carried water across deserts.
ex.zh: 波斯坎儿井把水引过沙漠。

senses.en: someone who writes or edits dictionaries

ex.en: My aunt works as a lexicographer for a small publisher.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家小出版社做词典编纂工作。

ex.en: A lexicographer examines authentic language use to ensure that dictionary definitions reflect contemporary meanings accurately.
ex.zh: 词典编纂者研究真实的语言使用情况，以确保词典释义准确反映当代词义。

col: work as a lexicographer｜担任词典编纂者
a team of lexicographers｜词典编纂团队
a bilingual lexicographer｜双语词典编纂者
tip: 指编写或修订词典的人，不泛指语言学家。

senses.en: A raised farm plot built in a shallow lake.

ex.en: Aztec chinampas fed a huge city.
ex.zh: 阿兹特克浮园养活了一座大城市。

senses.en: Corn, a cereal crop first grown in Mexico.

ex.en: Maize was domesticated about 9,000 years ago.
ex.zh: 玉米大约在九千年前被驯化。

senses.en: A starchy tropical root crop.

ex.en: Manioc must be processed to remove poison.
ex.zh: 木薯必须经过处理去除毒素。

senses.en: A tropical plant with a starchy root.

ex.en: Cassava is a staple food in Africa.
ex.zh: 木薯是非洲的主食。

senses.en: A tropical plant grown for its edible root.

ex.en: Taro was carried across the Pacific.
ex.zh: 芋头被带到了整个太平洋地区。

senses.en: A grain crop that grows in dry conditions.

ex.en: Sorghum was domesticated in Africa.
ex.zh: 高粱在非洲被驯化。

senses.en: Rude and disrespectful, especially towards someone in authority.

ex.en: The waiter remained calm despite the customer's insolent tone.
ex.zh: 尽管顾客语气傲慢无礼，服务员仍保持冷静。

ex.en: Schools should address insolent behaviour firmly while helping students learn respectful ways to express disagreement.
ex.zh: 学校应坚决处理无礼行为，同时帮助学生学会以尊重他人的方式表达异议。

tip: 现代常用作形容词；对应名词是insolence。

senses.en: A small-seeded cereal crop.

ex.en: Millet was an early crop in northern China.
ex.zh: 粟是中国北方早期的作物。

senses.en: An ancient type of wheat.

ex.en: Emmer was one of the first crops.
ex.zh: 二粒小麦是最早的作物之一。

senses.en: Tamed or grown for human use.

ex.en: Dogs were the first domesticated animals.
ex.zh: 狗是最早被驯化的动物。

senses.en: A starchy tropical root vegetable.

ex.en: Yam festivals celebrate the harvest.
ex.zh: 山药节庆祝丰收。

senses.en: A cereal grain used for food and brewing.

ex.en: Barley was grown in the Fertile Crescent.
ex.zh: 大麦种植于新月沃土。

senses.en: A small round seed eaten as food.

ex.en: Lentils were among the first domesticated plants.
ex.zh: 小扁豆是最早被驯化的植物之一。

senses.en: A plant grown for fiber and seed.

ex.en: Linen is made from flax.
ex.zh: 亚麻布是用亚麻制成的。

senses.en: To make an official decision about a dispute
To judge performances or entries in a competition

ex.en: An independent expert will adjudicate our dispute over the repairs.
ex.zh: 一位独立专家将裁决我们在维修问题上的争议。

ex.en: Independent bodies should adjudicate disputes between consumers and businesses to ensure that complaints receive fair and consistent treatment.
ex.zh: 独立机构应裁决消费者与企业之间的纠纷，确保投诉得到公平且一致的处理。

col: adjudicate on a claim｜就索赔作出裁决
adjudicate a competition｜担任比赛评委
tip: 可直接接争议，也可用adjudicate on；不专指宣判刑罚。

senses.en: A highly decorated European style of art and music of the 1600s.

ex.en: Bach is a master of baroque music.
ex.zh: 巴赫是巴洛克音乐大师。

senses.en: A light, playful, highly decorated 18th-century style.

ex.en: The palace has rococo ceilings.
ex.zh: 宫殿有洛可可风格的天花板。

senses.en: Copying the style of ancient Greece and Rome.

ex.en: The bank has a neoclassical facade.
ex.zh: 这家银行有新古典主义风格的外立面。

senses.en: A revival of ancient Greek and Roman styles.

ex.en: Neoclassicism followed the rococo.
ex.zh: 新古典主义继洛可可之后兴起。

senses.en: A movement valuing emotion, nature and imagination.

ex.en: Romanticism celebrated wild landscapes.
ex.zh: 浪漫主义赞美原野风光。

senses.en: Showing things as they really are.

ex.en: Realism painted ordinary workers.
ex.zh: 现实主义描绘普通劳动者。

senses.en: To shout or laugh at someone in an unkind way.
An unkind shout or remark intended to ridicule someone.

ex.en: A few spectators jeered when the player missed again.
ex.zh: 那名球员再次失误时，几名观众发出了嘲笑声。

ex.en: When spectators jeer at inexperienced players, they create an atmosphere that discourages participation in community sport.
ex.zh: 当观众嘲笑缺乏经验的球员时，他们会营造出一种让人不愿参加社区体育活动的氛围。

col: jeers from the crowd｜人群中的嘲笑声
a chorus of jeers｜一片嘲笑声
tip: 动词常用 jeer at someone；名词常用复数。

senses.en: A style capturing light and momentary effects with visible brushstrokes.

ex.en: Impressionism began in Paris in the 1870s.
ex.zh: 印象派于19世纪70年代在巴黎兴起。

senses.en: An artist of impressionism.

ex.en: Monet is the best-known impressionist.
ex.zh: 莫奈是最著名的印象派画家。

senses.en: A style showing inner feelings rather than outward reality.

ex.en: Expressionism used bold, distorted colors.
ex.zh: 表现主义使用大胆、扭曲的色彩。

senses.en: Relating to expressionism.

ex.en: The Scream is an expressionist painting.
ex.zh: 《呐喊》是一幅表现主义画作。

senses.en: Relating to cubism, which shows objects from many angles at once.

ex.en: Picasso painted cubist portraits.
ex.zh: 毕加索画立体派肖像。

senses.en: A movement showing dreamlike, irrational images.

ex.en: Melting clocks are a famous image of surrealism.
ex.zh: 融化的钟表是超现实主义的著名意象。

senses.en: Unwilling or reluctant to do something.

ex.en: I was loth to leave the warm kitchen.
ex.zh: 我不愿离开温暖的厨房。

ex.en: Some residents are loth to support redevelopment because they fear losing their neighbourhood's distinctive character.
ex.zh: 一些居民不愿支持重建，因为他们担心失去社区独有的特色。

tip: loath的较少见变体；常用be loth to do。

senses.en: Relating to surrealism.

ex.en: Dalí was a leading surrealist.
ex.zh: 达利是超现实主义的代表人物。

senses.en: An early 20th-century movement celebrating speed and machines.

ex.en: Futurism glorified cars and factories.
ex.zh: 未来主义颂扬汽车和工厂。

senses.en: A movement breaking with traditional forms in the early 20th century.

ex.en: Modernism rejected decoration.
ex.zh: 现代主义摒弃装饰。

senses.en: Relating to modernism.

ex.en: The modernist building is made of glass and steel.
ex.zh: 这座现代主义建筑由玻璃和钢构成。

senses.en: A late 20th-century movement mixing styles and questioning tradition.

ex.en: Postmodernism mixes high and popular culture.
ex.zh: 后现代主义把高雅文化与大众文化混合。

senses.en: Relating to postmodernism.

ex.en: The postmodern tower borrows classical columns.
ex.zh: 这座后现代塔楼借用了古典柱式。

senses.en: harmful or poisonous to people or other living things

ex.en: Noxious fumes from the spill forced everyone to leave.
ex.zh: 泄漏物产生的有毒烟气迫使所有人离开。

ex.en: Stricter controls on industrial emissions are needed to protect nearby communities from exposure to noxious gases.
ex.zh: 需要更严格地控制工业排放，以保护附近社区免受有毒气体侵害。

tip: 常形容气体或物质；不只是气味难闻。

senses.en: A style using very few simple elements.

ex.en: Minimalism favors empty space.
ex.zh: 极简主义偏爱留白。

senses.en: Using very few simple elements.

ex.en: The apartment has a minimalist design.
ex.zh: 这套公寓采用极简设计。

senses.en: Art not showing real objects; a general idea.

ex.en: Kandinsky moved toward pure abstraction.
ex.zh: 康定斯基走向了纯抽象。

senses.en: Showing recognizable figures; not literal.

ex.en: She paints figurative scenes of daily life.
ex.zh: 她画描绘日常生活的具象场景。

senses.en: Showing things as they look.

ex.en: Representational art depicts real objects.
ex.zh: 具象艺术描绘真实物体。

senses.en: New and experimental in art or ideas.

ex.en: The gallery shows avant-garde work.
ex.zh: 这家画廊展出先锋派作品。

senses.en: A system or machine sending document copies over telephone lines.
To send a document using a fax machine.

ex.en: The office still has a telefax beside the printer.
ex.zh: 办公室的打印机旁边还放着一台传真机。

ex.en: Before email became widespread, companies relied on telefax to exchange documents quickly across national borders.
ex.zh: 在电子邮件普及之前，公司依靠传真来快速跨国交换文件。

col: send by telefax｜通过传真发送
tip: 较旧的说法；现代英语通常直接用fax。

senses.en: Relating to a medieval style with pointed arches; dark and mysterious.

ex.en: Notre-Dame is a gothic cathedral.
ex.zh: 巴黎圣母院是一座哥特式大教堂。

senses.en: A medieval style with round arches and thick walls.

ex.en: The romanesque church has small windows.
ex.zh: 这座罗马式教堂窗户很小。

senses.en: Relating to the Byzantine Empire; very complicated.

ex.en: Byzantine mosaics glitter with gold.
ex.zh: 拜占庭马赛克闪着金光。

senses.en: An architectural style of massive bare concrete.

ex.en: Brutalism was popular for public buildings.
ex.zh: 粗野主义曾流行于公共建筑。

senses.en: A painting made on wet plaster.

ex.en: Michelangelo painted frescoes on the chapel ceiling.
ex.zh: 米开朗基罗在礼拜堂天花板上画了湿壁画。

senses.en: Paint made with egg yolk.

ex.en: Medieval icons were painted in tempera.
ex.zh: 中世纪圣像用蛋彩绘制。

senses.en: generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival or weaker person

ex.en: She was magnanimous and congratulated her rival warmly.
ex.zh: 她很有雅量，热情地向对手表示祝贺。

ex.en: A magnanimous response to criticism can help leaders build trust and encourage constructive public debate.
ex.zh: 领导者宽宏大量地回应批评，有助于建立信任并促进建设性的公共讨论。

col: a magnanimous gesture｜宽宏大量的举动
tip: 较正式，常形容对对手或冒犯者宽容大度。

senses.en: Opaque watercolor paint.

ex.en: The poster was painted in gouache.
ex.zh: 这张海报是用水粉画的。

senses.en: Paint mixed with water, or a picture painted with it.

ex.en: She painted the harbor in watercolor.
ex.zh: 她用水彩画了港口。

senses.en: A soft colored crayon; pale and soft in color.

ex.en: Degas drew dancers in pastel.
ex.zh: 德加用粉彩画舞者。

senses.en: A print made from a metal plate marked with acid.

ex.en: Rembrandt made many etchings.
ex.zh: 伦勃朗创作了许多蚀刻版画。

senses.en: A design cut into a hard surface, or a print made from it.

ex.en: The book has fine engravings of birds.
ex.zh: 这本书有精美的鸟类版画。

senses.en: A print made from a flat stone or metal plate.

ex.en: The poster is a colored lithograph.
ex.zh: 这张海报是彩色石版画。

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or moral boundary

ex.en: Players who transgress the rules may leave the game.
ex.zh: 违反规则的选手可能离场。

ex.en: Companies that transgress environmental laws should face penalties proportionate to the damage they cause.
ex.zh: 违反环境法律的企业应受到与其造成的损害相称的处罚。

col: transgress moral boundaries｜逾越道德界限
transgress social norms｜违反社会规范
tip: 正式用词，可直接接law、rules等宾语。

senses.en: Printing from a flat surface treated to hold ink.

ex.en: Lithography made posters cheap.
ex.zh: 平版印刷让海报变得便宜。

senses.en: A print made from a carved block of wood.

ex.en: Japanese woodcuts influenced European artists.
ex.zh: 日本木刻版画影响了欧洲艺术家。

senses.en: Creating art by printing from a carved or treated surface.

ex.en: Printmaking allows many copies of one image.
ex.zh: 版画能把一幅图像印制许多份。

senses.en: Printing by pressing ink through a fine mesh.

ex.en: Warhol used silkscreen for his portraits.
ex.zh: 沃霍尔用丝网印刷制作肖像。

senses.en: A heavy cloth with pictures woven into it.

ex.en: The tapestry shows a medieval hunt.
ex.zh: 这幅挂毯描绘了中世纪的狩猎。

senses.en: A stand that holds a painting while it is made.

ex.en: The artist set up her easel by the river.
ex.zh: 画家在河边支起画架。

senses.en: A board for mixing paint; a range of colors.

ex.en: The painter used a warm palette.
ex.zh: 画家使用了暖色调。

senses.en: the right to vote in elections

ex.en: The women's suffrage movement grew in the 1900s.
ex.zh: 二十世纪初妇女选举权运动兴起。

ex.en: Universal suffrage meant that, for the first time, every adult citizen could vote regardless of property or gender.
ex.zh: 普选权意味着所有成年公民首次不分财产和性别都能投票。

senses.en: A mark made by a paintbrush.

ex.en: Van Gogh's brushstrokes are thick and swirling.
ex.zh: 梵高的笔触浓重而旋动。

senses.en: Paint laid on so thickly that brush marks stand out.

ex.en: Impasto gives the surface texture.
ex.zh: 厚涂法使画面富有质感。

senses.en: The use of strong contrasts between light and dark.

ex.en: Caravaggio was a master of chiaroscuro.
ex.zh: 卡拉瓦乔是明暗对照法的大师。

senses.en: Soft blending of tones without sharp outlines.

ex.en: Leonardo used sfumato in the Mona Lisa.
ex.zh: 达·芬奇在《蒙娜丽莎》中使用了晕涂法。

senses.en: Drawing an object shorter to show depth.

ex.en: Foreshortening makes the arm seem to reach out.
ex.zh: 透视缩短法让手臂看起来向外伸出。

senses.en: Lack of balance between two halves.

ex.en: Japanese gardens favor asymmetry.
ex.zh: 日本庭园偏爱不对称。

senses.en: To divide or spread into branches or connected parts.

ex.en: The tree's roots ramify beneath the old garden wall.
ex.zh: 这棵树的根在花园旧围墙下分叉延伸。

ex.en: As transport networks ramify across rural regions, previously isolated communities gain better access to essential services.
ex.zh: 随着交通网络在农村地区不断延伸，原本偏远的社区更容易获得基本服务。

tip: 正式且少见，常指根系、血管或网络分叉延伸。

senses.en: A dark shape seen against a light background.

ex.en: The castle's silhouette rose against the sunset.
ex.zh: 城堡的剪影映衬在夕阳中。

senses.en: The art of making portraits.

ex.en: Dutch portraiture flourished in the 1600s.
ex.zh: 荷兰肖像画在17世纪蓬勃发展。

senses.en: A portrait an artist makes of themselves.

ex.en: Frida Kahlo painted many self-portraits.
ex.zh: 弗里达·卡罗画了许多自画像。

senses.en: A painting or statue of an unclothed person.

ex.en: The museum's classical nudes are marble.
ex.zh: 博物馆里的古典裸体雕像是大理石的。

senses.en: A story or picture with a hidden moral or political meaning.

ex.en: The painting is an allegory of justice.
ex.zh: 这幅画是正义的寓言。

senses.en: Having a hidden symbolic meaning.

ex.en: Allegorical figures represent the seasons.
ex.zh: 寓意人物代表四季。

senses.en: a system where employees reserve shared workspaces instead of permanent desks

ex.en: With hotelling, I book a desk before coming in.
ex.zh: 采用工位预约共享制后，我来上班前会先预订工位。

ex.en: Hotelling can reduce office costs, although employees may miss having a permanent space for their belongings.
ex.zh: 工位预约共享制可以降低办公成本，不过员工可能会怀念拥有固定空间存放个人物品的日子。

col: office hotelling｜办公位预约共享制
hotelling system｜工位预约共享系统
tip: 通常指预约共享工位；旅馆业用hotel industry。
note: 真实词，亦拼作hoteling；现代常见义为办公位预约共享制，并非通常所说的旅馆业。

senses.en: Decoration added to something.

ex.en: The building has little ornamentation.
ex.zh: 这座建筑几乎没有装饰。

senses.en: Delicate decoration made of fine metal wire.

ex.en: The brooch has silver filigree.
ex.zh: 这枚胸针有银丝花饰。

senses.en: A thin layer of gold applied to a surface.

ex.en: The gilding on the frame has worn away.
ex.zh: 画框上的贴金已经磨掉了。

senses.en: Covered with a thin layer of gold.

ex.en: A gilt mirror hung in the hall.
ex.zh: 大厅里挂着一面镀金镜子。

senses.en: Financial support given by a patron.

ex.en: Medici patronage supported many artists.
ex.zh: 美第奇家族的赞助支持了许多艺术家。

senses.en: An artist's or designer's workshop.

ex.en: She trained in a Paris atelier.
ex.zh: 她在巴黎的一家工作室接受训练。

senses.en: Until now or until the time being discussed.

ex.en: The repair revealed a hitherto hidden cupboard upstairs.
ex.zh: 这次维修让楼上一个此前一直隐藏着的壁橱显露了出来。

ex.en: Recent archaeological discoveries have revealed hitherto unknown details about trade between ancient coastal communities.
ex.zh: 近期的考古发现揭示了此前未知的古代沿海社区间贸易的细节。

tip: 正式用语，常见于hitherto unknown等搭配。

senses.en: A person learning a trade from a skilled worker.

ex.en: Leonardo was an apprentice to Verrocchio.
ex.zh: 达·芬奇曾是韦罗基奥的学徒。

senses.en: An expert judge of art or taste.

ex.en: A connoisseur spotted the forgery.
ex.zh: 一位鉴赏家识破了赝品。

senses.en: The study of beauty and taste; the look of something.

ex.en: Aesthetics asks what makes art beautiful.
ex.zh: 美学探究是什么让艺术美。

senses.en: To make a figure by carving or shaping material.

ex.en: She sculpted the figure from clay.
ex.zh: 她用黏土塑出了这个人像。

senses.en: Pouring liquid metal into a mold; choosing actors for roles.

ex.en: Bronze casting is an ancient technique.
ex.zh: 青铜铸造是一门古老的技艺。

senses.en: A sculpture that stands out only slightly from its background.

ex.en: The temple walls are covered in bas-relief.
ex.zh: 神庙墙壁上布满浅浮雕。
